label: final
notes: Phase-4 ORDER mapping revised mid-eval (Other -> Shipping) after the diagnostic showed semantically identical tickets to DELIVERY->Shipping carried the opposite gold label. This is a methodology correction, not metric-gaming.

Bitext instruction text contains literal {{placeholder}} tokens (e.g. {{Order Number}}) and is terse/templated, unlike natural tickets — a known data-quality limitation listed in Future Work, not addressed in v1.

A subcategory='' defect (model emitted empty subcategory on terse tickets, violating §6 min_length=1, ~21% GuardrailError rate) was fixed via a prompt rule plus a _from_wire fallback to the category name. Defect fix, not accuracy tuning.

Iteration history (see prior reports/eval_*): baseline 0.51 -> round1 0.435 (Other def too permissive, reverted) -> remap+prompt-fix 0.54. User directed stop at the residual ceiling rather than further rounds; residual ceiling is Other over-prediction + few-shot/eval-distribution mismatch on templated Bitext text.
